macro_set_equality_proof: For a frozen candidate pair (a,b), each original width-8 product clause is either untouched at width 8 with no extension literal, or has a and b removed and fresh -e inserted, producing width 7.
The three definition clauses have widths 2, 2 and 3 and are exactly (-e,-a), (-e,-b), and (e,a,b).
A definition clause cannot subsume an untouched clause because untouched clauses contain no e or -e.
The positive-e definition cannot subsume a replaced clause because every replaced clause contains -e and not e.
A negative-e width-2 definition cannot subsume a replaced clause: the source clause contained a and b and was tautology-free, so after a and b are removed its remainder cannot contain -a or -b.
A replaced clause cannot subsume an untouched clause because it contains fresh -e; an untouched clause cannot subsume a replaced clause because it lacks -e and has greater width.
Within either the untouched width-8 class or replaced width-7 class, distinct equal-width clauses cannot strictly subsume one another.
Therefore original canon_cnf performs only exact set deduplication on these macro rows. The specialized backend constructs precisely the same clause set.
raw_elimination_equivalence_proof: Both implementations partition the identical macro CNF into positive-pivot parents, negative-pivot parents and retained clauses.

Both enumerate the complete Cartesian product of complementary parents, remove the pivot literals, discard a resolvent exactly when its positive and negative literal masks intersect, and charge each non-tautological resolvent only on first insertion into the raw unique set.
Both start from state_units(retained)=1+sum over retained clauses of (1+width), then add exactly 1+width for each new raw resolvent.

The raw unique set and its final unit charge are independent of parent enumeration order. Thus FIT if and only if final raw units are at most N^2, and OVERFLOW if and only if final raw units exceed N^2, are identical.

The positive amount observed at the first cap crossing may differ with enumeration order; that diagnostic amount is not used as an exact value of Delta or Gamma. Only its strict positivity is used as a cap-crossing certificate.
